hero.title: Public Health in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: **Public Health in Mauritius for Indian Students** is a study pathway for students interested in disease prevention, health promotion, epidemiology, healthcare policy and improving health at the community and population levels. Unlike clinical degrees focused primarily on treating individual patients, public health programmes examine how health systems, environments, behaviours and social conditions affect entire communities. Students who want to **Study Public Health in Mauritius** can explore postgraduate opportunities and related academic pathways.

highlights.title: Bilingual & English Degrees
highlights.desc: Study in English with recognized qualifications from national institutions and global UK/Australian branch campuses.

highlights.title: Affordable Tuition & Living
highlights.desc: High quality tertiary education with tuition fees and living costs substantially lower than Western Europe.

highlights.title: Safe & Multicultural Island
highlights.desc: Consistently ranked as the safest and most politically stable nation in Africa with close cultural ties to India.

highlights.title: Simplified Visa Process
highlights.desc: Streamlined student visa procedures arranged directly through recognized higher education institutions.

overview: The Master of Public Health (MPH) is a relevant postgraduate option for graduates in medicine, nursing, pharmacy, biology, environmental sciences and other eligible disciplines. The University of Mauritius has published an MPH programme, while the Open University of Mauritius has documented an MPH offered in collaboration with Imperial College London. Applicants must verify the current intake, programme arrangements and fees before applying. **Edu-Hawk Worldwide** encourages students to check the latest admission and programme details before making a decision.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Public Health in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Public Health in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Public Health in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
